newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares continue firm but volumes small.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares continue firm but volumes small.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares continued their upward march in active trade on Tuesday but volumes were thin on lack of scrip, brokers said.
"The market was very strong and very busy although we didn't see big volumes," one broker said.

The key industrial index rose 24.36 points to close at a new all time high of 7,772.15, pushed up largely by 50-cent gains each in cement producer Circle, hotel and supermarkets group Meikles and sugar refinery ZSR to 600, 2,050 and 1,400 cents respectively.

Also among the day's winners, tyre firm NTS rose 35 cents to 470, soft drinks manufacturer Schweppes gained 30 cents to 770 while finance group Finhold at 1,000, clothing retailer Truworths at 725 and publishers Zimpapers at 1,875 all climbed 25 cents.
Against the trend, hotel chain Zimsun dropped 15 cents to 410 and wineries Afdis shed 10 cents to 465.
Minings continued quiet with gold producer Rio Tinto leaping 200 cents to 3,500. But Wankie Colliery eased five cents to 355.
The mining index edged 2.53 points up to end at 1,258.48.
